title: Information System on Commercial Designations for Fishery and Aquaculture Products
description: The subject of this call for tenders is the running and maintenance of the information system on commercial designations for fishery and aquaculture products (FAPs).This information system is a database of all information related to commercial designations of fishery and aquaculture products, and an expert system which enables the analysis of the consistency of the various data and their extraction in all community languages. The data are publicly made available by the European Commission on a dedicated web page.It provides the European consumer and, more generally, all EU and non-EU stakeholders (producers, fishmongers, processors, importers, retailers, customs and sanitary services) guarantees of transparency and accuracy as regards one of the key elements of the labelling of FAPs.The information system is ultimately aimed at being a simple and accessible means to promote a responsible and sustainable fishery and consumption of FAPs.

ragText:
Procurement: Framework contract for information and communication activities relating to the EU integrated maritime policy (IMP) and to the common fisheries policy (CFP).
Call identifier: MARE/2016/11.
Contracting authority: null
Description: The objective of the framework contract is to help explain, promote, implement and develop the IMP and CFP as well as raise public awareness of the objectives, issues and initiatives in these areas. This framework service contract will also include services for the Executive Agency for Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (EASME) and for the European Fisheries Control Agency (EFCA).
The call for tenders covers the following tasks and services:
A) designing, implementing and following up information and communication campaigns;
B) editorial tasks, creation of content and development of communication materials and management of databases for the distribution of information material and other purposes;
C) audiovisual services;
D) support to digital communication and online activities;
E) organisation of participation in events and fairs;
F) support for media relations.

title: Information system on commercial designations for fishery and aquaculture products
description: The subject of this call for tenders is the running and maintenance of an the Information System on Commercial Designations for Fishery and Aquaculture Products (FAPs). This information system is a database of all information related to commercial designations of fishery and aquaculture products, and an expert system which enables the analysis of the consistency of the various data and their extraction in all EU languages. The data are publicly made available by the European Commission on a dedicated web page. It provides the European consumer and, more generally, all EU and non-EU stakeholders (producers, fishmongers, processors, importers, retailers, customs and sanitary services) guarantees of transparency and accuracy as regards one of the key elements of the labelling of FAPs. The information system is ultimately aimed at being a simple and accessible means to promote a responsible and sustainable fishery and consumption of FAPs.

title: European market observatory for fisheries and aquaculture products (EUMOFA)
description:
The purpose of the contract is to ensure the continuity of the services currently delivered by EUMOFA and to implement, run and maintain a fully-fledged market intelligence service on EU fisheries and aquaculture markets.The operational objectives of EUMOFA are to collect, harmonise, analyse and disseminate data and conduct market analyses on the EU market for fisheries and aquaculture products along the supply chain and make this information publicly available, in all or certain EU languages.The service will take over and improve the existing services of EUMOFA (www.eumofa.eu), and will ensure dissemination of results and communication on EUMOFA services. Emphasis should be put on supporting producer organisations (POs) and inter-branch organisations (IBOs) to better coordinate information between operators and processors.The expected services are: 
 1) Data collection, 
 2) Reports, studies and market analysis, 
 3) Dissemination and communication activities, 
 4) IT Services.

title: Interim evaluation of the implementation of the direct management component of the Regulation (EU) No 508/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council (European Maritime and Fisheries Fund (EMFF) Regulation (Articles 15 and 125)).
description:
The aim of this independent evaluation study is to feed into an interim evaluation of the implementation of the direct management component of Regulation (EU) No 508/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 15.5.2014 on the European Maritime and Fisheries Fund and repealing Council Regulations (EC) No 2328/2003, (EC) No 861/2006, (EC) No 1198/2006 and (EC) No 791/2007 and Regulation (EU) No 1255/2011 of the European Parliament and of the Council (EMFF). It satisfies the need for a midterm review as stipulated in Articles 15 and 125 of that Regulation.
The evaluation findings, conclusions and recommendations will feed into implementation of subsequent direct management spending by the EMFF and possibly an adjustment of the indicative distribution of funds as laid down in Annex III of the EMFF Regulation. In addition, this evaluation will also feed into the ex ante impact assessment of the ‘new EMFF’ for the programming period after 2020 (planned for 2017).

The maintenance covers content management and some developments aiming at improving the system to take into account needs for new or different functionalities as well as technological changes.

Procurement: Information system on commercial designations for fishery and aquaculture products.
Call identifier: MARE/2016/16.
Contracting authority: null
Description: The subject matter of the contract is the maintenance of the database of information related to commercial designations of fisheries and aquaculture products (FAPs) marketed in the European Union and of the related information system for the dissemination of this information online on a dedicated web page. This service builds up on the database and information system which were developed in the framework of a pilot project. The pilot system must now be run on a permanent basis. The information system will be hosted by the European Commission. The maintenance covers content management and some developments aiming at improving the system to take into account needs for new or different functionalities as well as technological changes.

description:

title: Engine Power: support Technical Working Group and development of Guidelines
description:
Please note that this is not a call for tenders but a publication announcing the Contracting authority’s intention to publish a future negotiated low or middle valueprocedure. 
DG MARE will procure the services of an external service provider with expert knowledge in the field engine power monitoring, certification and verification procedures to 1) support and advice the Technical Working Group on Engine Power and to prepare a guidance document ‘Technical guidelines for the monitoring, certification and verification of engine power in EU fisheries control’, and 2) to develop guidelines on continuous monitoring of engine power in support of the development of implementing rules under the future Control Regulation [Council Regulation (EC) No 1224/2009].
